verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Kintsugi as a US-style sales-tax/nexus compliance API (nexus tracking, product taxability, exemptions, filings) with no mention of VAT, VAT ID validation against registries like VIES, or reverse-charge mechanics for B2B cross-border EU sales. Since tax compliance APIs could plausibly support VAT validation and reverse charge, this axis applies, but there is no evidence Kintsugi delivers it.
